notes.title: Events Galore with Mexican Entertainment System, Six One Indie, and TGS! 🪅
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/29b4705ec31e84b64a92a03dc3b5958486f5d271.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hey there, explorers![/b] While our [i]Tour of Explora [/i]continues, we also continue participating in events! [i]Townseek [/i]has been going on quite an adventure and we're not stopping any time soon! ⛵[/p][p][b]This time, we're having the opportunity to feature the game in[/b] [b]three amazing events at once![/b] All these events are happening at the same time over this week and the next, so please, check out the sale pages for each of them. You might even find something you could play while waiting for [i]Townseek[/i]! 🧭[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/bb15a854bdc0d57103f8c1835266dc2b3eb580ca.png"][/img][/p][p][b]First up, we're participating in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MexicanEntertainmentSystem2025"][u][i]Mexican Entertainment System[/i][/u][/url]![/b] If you've been around a while, you'll know that we've already participated in it a few times already. Our team is half Mexican and half Portuguese, collaborating from across the ocean and in-person at times. Add in our publisher and media partners, and the game truly is a multicultural effort, just like the game portrays! 🪅[/p][p][b]The event is a perfect way to celebrate [i]Mexican [/i]culture and its indie scene![/b] While we haven't reached the stop that represents each of our cultures as developers in the game during our tour yet, rest assured there's plenty of inspiration from [i]Mexico, Portugal [/i]and a bit from all over the world throughout it! We can't wait to show you those towns! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/aeba1a8e298efdbedddaed9b01053dd4cd5b7cca.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/0baf0e7198dcbafd99207f943f691cf3988da6e0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Next, we're participating in the [i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45119430-Six-One-Indie/sale/sixoneindieshowcasefall2025"]Six One Indie Showcase[/url][/i], a big celebration of indie games![/b] Our publisher at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SUPERRAREGAMES?snr=1_5_9__408"][u][i]Super Rare Originals[/i][/u][/url][i] [/i]is debuting some exciting announcements including a first look at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][u][i]Moros Protocol[/i][/u][/url]! It's a fantastic opportunity to see [i]Townseek [/i]alongside other amazing indie games and get a taste of what's coming next in indie games. 🐦[/p][p][b]Finally, we're also heading to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TGS2025"][u][i]Tokyo Games Show[/i][/u][/url], where our media partner at [i]Gamersky [/i]is taking us[/b]! While we'd love to visit the city in person, they'll be handling the showcases of the game for us there. We're still confirming the details with them about how the game is going to be presented in person at the event, but if you're headed to [i]Tokyo[/i], you have the chance to try out the game for yourself too! 🗼[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/19c8ccc498e88495b1b47051b78b4062e647216d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]While we're participating in these events, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014110/Townseek_Demo/"][u][i]Townseek [/i][/u][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014110/Townseek_Demo/"][u]demo continues being ready for you to play on [i]Steam[/i][/u][/url]![/b] Explore new towns, trade over 200 items, upgrade your airship, discover landmarks, encounter random events, and enjoy all the new features we've been working on. [b]Your demo save will carry over to the full game so you'll be able to pick up right where you left from! 🦈[/b][/p][p][b]Like we've mentioned in previous posts, we continue to work on implementing some new features and language support in the demo. [/b]That update is coming really soon, so thank you for waiting so far! 🙏 Meanwhile, like always, you're free to [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1659360/discussions/"][u]share your feedback or reviews here on [i]Steam[/i][/u][/url], or [url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"][u]join our [i]Discord[/i] [i]Server [/i]and tell us what you think[/u][/url], or what you're looking the most forward to![/p][p][b]Set sail, explore and look out for the adventures that await you this week.[/b] [b]The whole world is your sea now! Cheers![/b] [/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Finding a new spark of creativity at Driplands! 🌈
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/93c62824440c1c79a3106f59db9075db8339572d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hop onboard, as it's time for us to continue our [i]Tour of Explora[/i]![/b] Now that we've visited the underwater town of [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542238653775086821"][i]Sharkdwell[/i][/url] and the furry settlement of [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542239288195023603"][i]Meowosville[/i][/url], we're heading towards a colourful, majestic swamp! Watch out where you land your ship. The swamp water can be hard to wash off![/p][p][b]This time, our stop is at [i]Driplands, [/i]a place that is a town as much as an endless, rainbow swamp! 🌈 [/b]The lands around the town are covered in very colourful goop. You'll know you're there when you see a giant iron water faucet on the horizon! Even if you're travelling on your own, you can't miss it.[/p][p][b]Put on your best raincoat, some tall boots, and let's meet the locals![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/256dcd8f9d5d395f39afa0fd514c1d31451b5e12.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/e9ef454b852e3f04c80e4f77fe657eab7f6f648f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]When the goo from the [i]Pastel Falls[/i] merged with the [i]Mossy Marsh[/i], the first slimefolk were born![/b] With time, they learned that the substance that gave them life had a lot of handy properties, like solidifying, medicine, jewellery, and more, and built their own town from it. To control the flow more properly, they built the [i]Giant Faucet[/i], placed right in the middle of their town. You'll find them to be a creative bunch. They have experts in art, fashion, cooking, and all sorts of creative works they make from [i]slop[/i].[/p][p][b]More to the south, where the colour stops and the vegetation starts to become denser, one can find the [i]Mossy Marsh[/i]![/b] It takes some time to get used to the smell of nature, but just because it’s slimy doesn’t mean it doesn’t have its charm. Crocodiles, flies and even a frog playing a banjo are proud of calling it home. [/p][p][b]And if you’ve got a [i]Pickaxe[/i], you can help yourself to some minerals at the [i]Boggy Quarry[/i], where gold [i]does[/i] grow on trees![/b] Oh, and there's gems and artefacts to find too, but we didn't want to ruin the punchline. ⛏️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/ce0adf90ee5020e2878de43ab64f2e15666c26a0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]If you want to trade and do business at [i]Driplands[/i], you should go see [i]Blubbie[/i]! [/b]As the owner of the rapidly growing goo fashion brand [i]Bubbline[/i], she's usually busy making new designs, but she'll make some time for you! Her [i]Rainbow Necklace[/i] goes with anything, her [i]Bath Bubbles[/i] are very relaxing, and if you're hungry, treat yourself to some [i]Slopsagna[/i]![/p][p][b]But don't forget that she is a visionary![/b] [i]Blubbie's[/i] designs are rainproof and waterproof, yet it’s never enough! She's always looking for more ideas and inspiration to craft her art. ✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/ed1b36480be5d0806e574f7cf1a1714eadd9eda9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The reputation of the [i]Bubbline[/i] fashion brand didn't build overnight, and neither does yours! [/b]As with any other town, [i]Blubbie[/i] is always on the lookout for people that would accept some quests and odd jobs from her, in exchange for money, rewards and, of course, [i]Town Reputation[/i]![/p][p][b][i]Town Reputation[/i] is a special value for each town that tracks how much you've interacted with each town.[/b] From selling new items, to completing town quests, towns will track how much you've done for them. [b]As you accumulate [i]T[/i]own [i]Reputation[/i], you'll level up your [i]T[/i]own [i]Rank.[/i][/b] Doing so, will unlock you new items, like cosmetics for your airship and extra upgrades, alongside even more quests. Later quests come with extra-valuable rewards such as [i]Stardust[/i], [i]Super Water, [/i]and even more special resources we'll talk about later.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/d5e91a0d751b23e707a6abf2a0a522c935b5e85e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Town quests can also be repeated and will replenish over time! [/b]Unlike the story quests where you seek and fill the lost diary of [i]Sir Reginald Sharkingston[/i], these can be done multiple times for more reputation and rewards. You'll have a limited amount of town quests you can take at each time. As you increase your town rank, you'll also be able to take more town quests. [i]Hurray for interconnected systems![/i] ✨[/p][p][b]At [i]Driplands[/i], [i]Blubbie [/i]will often ask you to get materials for her designs.[/b] And if there is some demand, some slimefolk might want to hitch a ride to visit a tourist spot! Most importantly, since [i]Blubbie[/i] herself rarely has any chance to leave her workshop, she is likely to request from you some photo shots of amazing places for inspiration! [b]Grab a [i]Camera[/i] from her inventory and go snap some photos![/b] 📷[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/1ecd77519c22cf197e981e5fae6e98305516d24a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]For this week's behind-the-scenes and with such a unique species of townsfolk, we've got to talk about how we go about creating the fantastical but believable characters that populate [i]Explora[/i]! [/b]Very early in development of the jam version, we created [i]Blubbie[/i] to showcase that this wouldn't just be a game about anthropomorphic animals. Rather, we wanted to show we could have all kinds of species if we wanted, even magical ones. However, we also wanted them to feel like they could coexist, while still having quirks that separated them from one another, to further differentiate their cultures.[/p][p][i]Blubbie[/i], for example, was originally created to parody the anime slime girl archetype. Throughout development, as we explored that slimefolk were mostly liquid that changed shape and form at will, we made her design more gooey and unique. For their world building, we also figured that this meant that slimes could be whatever shape, form and gender they wanted at any given time, appearing as they saw fit. There are other characters in [i]Explora[/i] whose design also allows exploring how the characters approach their identities.[/p][p][b]This approach also created a lot of fun challenges and domino effects that impacted the world. [/b]For example, like we've talked about in [i]Sharkdwell[/i], instead of creating anthropomorphic sharks that had legs and could walk on land, we designed sharkfolk to need mechanical legs to do so. Later down the line, there are more characters whose physical design or species allowed for more storytelling opportunities! We hope you get to meet them soon! 😊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/f24ca996bf2ef1866e85c73521fc6efb8dbef840.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]If you've been keeping up with the posts we've been making, we've recently hosted a pets quest on our [url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"][i]Discord Server[/i][/url]! [/b]😺[i][b] [/b][/i]Folks had chance to submit their pets, and we'd pick a few to adapt into the game. We've got a lot of submissions! These are some of the pets that folks submitted and made it in as part of a first batch. Don't they look cute? 🐶[/p][p]We'll continue going through the submissions and picking some pets to add to the game as we carry on development. If you've missed participating in it and didn't submit your pet, you can share some photos of yours! [url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"][b]We've got a brand new [i]Discord Server[/i] channel for pets and friends, where pets are a part of the community all the time![/b][/url][b] 🐩[/b][/p][p][b]You can also be on the lookout for more [i]Townseek[/i] activities![/b] We know that not everyone has a pet, so we have more activities planned that will be more accessible for people who want to leave their impact in our game! 🌳[/p][p][b]Now, dry yourself, since we're continuing the tour! Things got a bit too energetic with the fuzzy cats and the splashy slimefolk. Let's take it easy and visit the calm farm lands at [i]Lawride Town[/i] next![/b] It's just a rural town, so it should be a relaxing stop. [i]What could possibly go wrong? 🍉[/i][/p][p][b]Have a rest, enjoy the voyage, and eat your veggies! We'll have plenty of them next time! Cheers! [/b]👋[/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Show us your pets and we'll add them to Townseek! 🐶
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/7ff7b3897da0c0245619849404e7a63b7d30bda9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Calling all pet owners and adorable pets! 🐱[/b] You might have noticed while playing our demo and throughout our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542239288195023603"][i]Tour of Explora[/i][/url] that [i]Townseek[/i] has many critters that liven up our world. Over the course of development, whenever we found the opportunity, we have added new animals and creatures that appear at random as you travel around, populating the different continents and places you visit. There's not only dogs, cats, and birds, but also more unique friends such as capybaras, kiwis, triceratops, and many more![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542239288195023603"][b]Since we've just highlighted a town all about cats[/b][/url][b], their close-by dog park and fish aquarium this week, we would like to give you the opportunity to have your own pets added in-game as critters! ✨ [/b]Be it dogs, cats, or any other animal you've got, we'd love to get the opportunity to meet some of your own pets, pick some of them, and introduce them in game as some of the critters that appear in the world![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/78c77e7a8689e3ff72511d129e71594114fbae7b.png"][/img][/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]If you'd like to submit your own pets, come over to our [/url][i][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]Discord Server[/url][/i][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]![/url][/b] [b]After you join, you can submit[/b] [b]your pets over at the [i][url="https://discord.com/channels/378239536939008000/1405259845283745812"]townseek-show-your-pets[/url][/i][/b] [b]channel![/b] Our team will then pick a handful to adapt into the game! You can send photos of any of your pets, no matter the type. If we pick your pet, we'll work closely with you to help finalise their design. We want to make sure that you can easily spot them in-game when it releases. 🔍[/p][p][b]As examples, here's how our artist turned their dog [i]Apple[/i] and our composer's cat [i]Bolinha[/i] into critters already![/b] 🐾[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/73f4ce0de1f3cdf810fd8fe5a618308e17964e5a.png"][/img][/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]Pet submissions are open until the 6th of September![/url][/b] 📌 Please make sure to submit them over on the channel there. No other channels or socials are applicable.[/p][p][b]If you can, please help us spread the word![/b] This is the first time we run something like this in a long while and we'd love as many people as possible to join in![/p][p][b]If you don't have any pets of your own, don't worry![/b] There'll be more [i]Townseek [/i]quests and contests that we've got planned leading up to launch! We'll let you know what's coming. For now, look forward to more [i]Tour of Explora [/i]as we head into [i]Driplands [/i]next week![/p][p][b]Well then, we look forward to meeting your pets! Cheers! 🐶[/b][/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Meeting the Crafty Felines at Meowosville! 🐱
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/bf06e43fde603f9c251deaebcb3586fc556d2d2c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]It's time to leave the seas and head to our next destination on our [i]Tour of Explora[/i]! [/b]In case you haven't caught up yet, last week, we started a tour of the different towns you can discover in [i]Townseek[/i], starting with [i][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542238653775086821"]Sharkdwell[/url][/i].[/p][p][b]This week, we're looking at the feline town of [i]Meowosville[/i]! [/b]As one would expect of cats, they really like cardboard and strings, and made their town to fit their needs. Being a close neighbour to [i]Sharkdwell[/i], it's one of the first towns you'll discover as you venture into land.[/p][p][b]Let's go meet these adorable yet crafty friends! Just keep an eye out for your belongings! [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/0371557ac3c3ac07e744784437aea7ea29cbb787.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/e03ebb1130f2a551a6c149bbdb6479950f7402ef.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Catfolk are very social and great explorers, and [i]Meowosville [/i]is surrounded by equally interesting creatures.[/b] They're friends to the sandcastle crabs at the beach south of the town, and unlike whatever one might expect, they love playing with the dogs at the nearby [i]Goodboi Park[/i]! Meanwhile, to the north, a group of territorial buff cats have claimed a cave and made it a gym for themselves. We recommend you admire their pectorals from a safe distance. 💪[/p][p][b]While [i]Meowosville[/i] is the home to most catfolk, they actually have a long history of travelling the world! [/b]It's said that they come from the faraway deserts of [i]Dunafar[/i] and that they crossed paths with the stone people of [i]Stonehedge[/i]. They're actually the most numerous species in [i]Explora[/i]! Keep your eyes peeled, and you might find some cats at some interesting locations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/b83adb4e2f710046839390ac03b8cf18f933b8dd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The merchant and host for [i]Meowosville [/i]is [i]Whiskey[/i], and at his store, you're the boss! [/b]✨ Like any good shopkeeper, [i]Whiskey [/i]will charm you into buying his wares, such as [i]Fish Burgers[/i] and [i]Squeaky Toys[/i]. But if he happens to snatch your pouch, don't be alarmed! That's how catfolk play! He'll give it back if you chase him, along with some round pebbles.[/p][p][b][i]Whiskey [/i]isn't the only trader in the family either. While [i]Whiskey [/i]prefers to stick around at home, his cousin [i]Pawline [/i]travels and trades the world in her own airship.[/b] You might even get to meet her during your own travels! You didn't think you were the only one flying around, did you?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/531bc8c4d3706ab58f97db91d1d6a207bd75a301.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fishing is also a big part of life at [i]Meowosville[/i]! [/b]While fish is important to their diet, most of their fishing is actually recreational! During the main quest for [i]Meowosville[/i], [i]Whiskey[/i] will introduce you to their prideful aquarium at [i]The Big Bowl[/i]. Once you get a fishing rod, which [i]Whiskey [/i]conveniently sells, he'll ask you to help fill it for an upcoming exhibition! 🎣[/p][p][b]Search for one of the many fishing spots around the world, like the nearby [i]Atlantis[/i], cast your rod and see what bites![/b] There are many different kinds of fish to catch, and they're also a great opportunity to make some quick money. But if you want to complete your collection, your fishing rod will need to get an upgrade at some point. 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/7944c4e54dd3b8cdc6303c758921782a54db9619.png"][/img][/p][p][b]For our behind-the-scenes development trivia for this week, [i]Meowosville [/i]was the first town we designed for [i]Townseek[/i], all the way back in its game jam version. [/b]As a quick proof of concept to figure out how we wanted towns and characters to look, we designed the host for the first town as a blue anthropomorphic cat in robes. That helped us set the tone and themes we'd need for the rest of the characters.[/p][p][b][i]Having a cat-themed town also gave us the opportunity to[/i][/b][i] [b]reference one of our previous[/b] [b]game jam games, Woofice Chair![/b] [/i]In it, the player would control a dog in an office chair, defending their park from various waves of extremely muscular animals, which inspired us to add the [i]Buff Cat Cave[/i] and [i]Goodboi Park[/i] to [i]Townseek[/i]. But worry not, the cats and the dogs sorted out their differences since.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/edc816ed3adec16ae00590da1f9ba2930c84aaa3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Speaking of cats and dogs, if you happen to be a pet owner, keep an eye out for more news early next week! 🐶 [/b]You might have noticed by now that the world is full of unique critters that we've created to populate the world. But what if some of your own pets managed to slip into [i]Explora[/i]? 🔍[/p][p]Anyway, it's time to head to the next stop on the tour! Put on your rain boots, since we'll be heading to the swamps of the [i]Driplands[/i] next! 🫧 [b][u][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]If you'd like to share your favourite bits of the tour so far, consider joining our [i]Discord[/i] server! Tell us what you liked about [i]Meowosville [/i]and what you'd like to see next on the tour![/url][/u][/b][/p][p][b]For now, have a safe voyage, and we'll catch you on our next stop next time! Cheers! 👋[/b][/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Go on a trip around the world during the Debut Festival! 🌟
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/9a3fceebab72a8728d427c7f094283f4ca755d7c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]If you've just been catching up with our [/b][b][i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1659360/view/542238653775086820"]Tour of Explora[/url][/u][/i][/b][b] that we kicked off this week with [i]Sharkdwell[/i], why not take the opportunity to go on a trip around the world?[/b] Our [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014110/Townseek_Demo/"]Townseek Demo[/url][/u][/i] is part of the [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gmdv/sale/debutfestival2025"]Debut Festival[/url][/u][/i] happening[i] [/i]right now! 🦈🌏[/p][p][b]The [i]Debut Festival[/i] version of our demo is the same as the one we took to [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1659360/view/542237641778659337"]BitSummit[/url][/u][/i] a few weeks ago, so there are no surprises for veteran explorers this time around.[/b] But if you haven't tried it yet, now is your chance to take to the skies, trade over 200 items between five unique towns, discover landmarks, and see what adventures await you across [i]Explora[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/a3ad3a06a84d8a78f913e400120fcc5b1471c5d9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/fd1e1f9be3cd2f85e9909e1da43cca9c1ac95d54.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We do want to let you know that we're still at work on adding new languages (including Japanese, Chinese, and others) to the demo and that the translations are going really well![/b] We're planning to have a new update to the demo with them and new quality-of-life improvements in the coming weeks. Thanks a lot to all of you who've left us your feedback! 👍[/p][p][b]Since this is the same demo, progress you make on it will carry over to the full game![/b] That means your collected items, journal pages, and cosmetics will all be waiting for you when Townseek releases in full. You'll be able to pick up your adventure right where you left off! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/7932c67361456851ef7fe51d2bc3b02ba2846cff.png"][/img][/p][p][b]These are exciting times for [i]Townseek[/i]![/b] [b]You can look forward to more news as we continue our [i]Tour of Explora[/i] next week with [i]Meowosville[/i]. We're also preparing some surprises you won't see coming! [/b]While we're keeping them under wraps for now, we can't wait to show you what's next on your journey.[/p][p][b]If you do set out on a trip during the festival, let us know what you think! You make us smile like a shark! Cheers! 🦈[/b][/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Presenting the Tour of Explora and Diving into Sharkdwell! 🦈
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/b898573b3c7b03c19037ffc79cba111a818a884a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gather around, explorers! ✨ With our [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/542237641778659338"]updated demo[/url][/u] and with [i]Townseek [/i]on the horizon, we thought now would be a great time to take you on a [i]Tour of Explora[/i]![/b] There's many unique places and cultures to discover within the world. With so many locations, every couple of weeks, we want to give you a closer look at some of the towns, characters and stories you'll meet in the game.[/p][p][b]What better way to start this tour than from the town that you come from? [/b]From under the waves and in the middle of the ocean, we're starting this tour with a closer look at the steampunk town of [i]Sharkdwell[/i], home to [i]Capt. Jawline[/i], [i]Sir. Reginald Sharkingston[/i] and, of course, to you! 🦈[/p][p][b]Let's get ready to depart on this journey together, shall we?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/47115de635487fde4c22e29de4b93bfacbfabc5f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/e7aed551dd1f9e37e51f925a207eafab4b21a196.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Sharkdwell[/i] is right at the centre of [i]Explora's [/i]vast ocean, and is a popular hub for trading![/b] Back in its former days, [i]Sharkdwell [/i]was an unremarkable mining town hidden deep away in the ocean. It became prosperous after [i]Sir. Reginald Sharkingston [/i]stumbled upon a cave full of a mineral he named [i]Sharknite[/i]. That mineral turned out to have amazing energetic properties and changed the town forever. With it, [i]Reginald[/i] helped fund and push through the invention of airships, the creation of mechanical legs, and the creation of [i]Sharkdwell's [/i]steampunk culture![/p][p][b]Over a century has passed since airships were invented, and merchants now roam the world, trading between towns. [/b]Nowadays, [i]Sharkdwell[/i] is the most important town of the ocean, and sharks are apex adventurers.[b] [/b]While the average shark doesn't interact much with outsiders, others depart to nearby towns, bringing goods from the land.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/63e4c9ab6fe90bc46d5fc91f96a18da04d99a442.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The merchant and host for [i]Sharkdwell [/i]is [i]Capt. Jawline[/i], your friend, mentor and boss, in that order![/b] [i]Jawline [/i]is a retired airship captain and spends his days as a merchant at [i]Sharkdwell[/i]. Alongside that, he works as an airship mechanic and helps train new sharks for exploring and trading. That includes you, his favourite pupil![/p][p][b][i]Jawline [/i]is also a direct descendant of [i]Sir. Reginald Sharkingston[/i].[/b] After tweaking your airship, [i]Jawline [/i]hands you [i]Reginald's Journal[/i], allowing you to use it as your own. As you learn the ropes of exploring and travelling around, he asks you to help him find its missing pages. Could there be a secret reason for his sudden request? 🤔[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/9c7f1a737577e4a9fb0df6654907d127637d5d48.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Sharkdwell [/i]stocks many unique items in its trade and some favourites among seafolk.[/b] Some of the common items you can find in stock include the [i]Algae Soup[/i], [i]Musical Conch[/i] and [i]Mechanical Legs[/i]. Experienced traders can also get their hands on more airship supplies, as well as a plethora of sea creatures that can tag along with you on your journey. 🪼[/p][p][b]Being in the middle of the ocean, most of what surrounds [i]Sharkdwell [/i]is water.[/b] But travel around, and you'll find places full of resources! There's the [i]Shark Depths[/i], the mine where Reginald first discovered [i]Sharknite[/i], and [i]Atlantis[/i], a fishing spot that fish love to gather around. While most of the landmarks you'll discover are on land, these places are a great way to start collecting items beyond trading.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/94734e23cc8222f66437695546b18c4f52adbb27.png"][/img][/p][p][b]As a bit of behind-the-scenes development, [i]Sharkdwell[/i] and the decision to theme the story around sharks were very much made up on the spot![/b] [i]Townseek [/i]was originally made for the [b][i][u][url="https://v3.globalgamejam.org/news/global-game-jam-presents-community-spotlight-townseek"]Global Game Jam[/url][/u][/i][/b][i] [/i]in 2021. Like every game made during a game jam, we had a tight time limit to work with and brainstorm ideas. When we were thinking about how to theme the player's blimp in a unique way, that's when the juxtaposition of a shark flying among the clouds came to us. And we went with it![/p][p]That led to everything else, from the idea of using a steampunk machine to fly around, to having the sharks take a central role in the world. For us, [i]Townseek [/i]is a game about how travel and getting to know the world changes you. [b]We thought there'd be no better way to represent that growth than going with a species that's never walked the land![/b][/p][p][b]This also presented a fun design challenge! [/b]Early on, we were split between the decision to have sharks walk on the surface or looking like traditional long-tailed sharks, we came up with the idea of mechanical legs that they could attach and detach at any time! This also helped us improve the story, and show how determined [i]Reginald[/i] was to explore and travel beyond [i]Sharkdwell[/i]. ⚙️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/ef630a3c466333991fdd77f806c6ee449dbfacff.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Well then! That was our first stop, and quite an important one to begin with! [/b]Next week, we're highlighting the catfolk town of [i]Meowosville[/i], so keep an eye out for those feline troublemakers![b] 🐱 [u][url="https://discord.gg/whalesandgames"]Meanwhile, feel free to join our [i]Discord [/i]server to talk about your favourite part of [i]Sharkdwell[/i] or which other towns you're eager for us to cover next![/url][/u][/b][/p][p][b]We'll catch you up ahead on the next stop, so get on your airship and set sail! Cheers! ✨[/b][/p][p][b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b][/p]

notes.title: Celebrating our awards as Studio of the Year and Best Game from Portugal! 🏆
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/bbadf8c86b6a3c584421469db2fd6bba9458f0bc.png[/img]
[b]In a surprising double-combo, at [i][url=https://devgamm.com/lisbon2024/]DevGAMM Lisbon[/url][/i], our team at [i]Whales And Games[/i] won the award for [url=https://www.linkedin.com/posts/game-dev-lisbon_spotlightawards-activity-7264252503855157248-SL_9][i]Studio of the Year[/i] during the [i]Spotlight Awards[/i][/url] by [i]Game Dev Lisbon[/i]! The very next day, [i][url=https://whalesandgames.com/games/townseek]Townseek[/url][/i] won the prize for [url=https://devgamm.com/awards2024/][i]Best Game from Portugal[/i] at the [i]DevGAMM Awards[/i][/url]![/b] 🏆 Receiving both these awards fills us with immense honour, and we're incredibly proud to receive them as a team! 🐳

[b]To commemorate the occasion, we've drawn a special artwork to celebrate both of these awards![/b] [i]Whalechan[/i], [i]Capt. Jawline[/i] and [i]Watt Zapp[/i] dressed in their fanciest outfits and were overjoyed to walk on stage to receive the awards! ⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/9b6fee50e53cac3f56b38aa1aee4d8fcb55297ca.png[/img]

[b]To explain the background to these awards, earlier this month, our team attended [i]DevGAMM Lisbon[/i], a local conference focused on talks, networking, and its award show![/b] Being two days long, it was a fantastic couple of days where we got to hang out with our colleagues, friends and meet even more developers from all over. It just so happens that networking with other developers is one of our favourite things to do! We also took the opportunity to attend some talks, take notes, and play some games. ✨

[b]This year, our team was nominated for two different award shows happening during the event. The first of these was the [i][url=https://spotlightawards.gamedevlisbon.com/]Spotlight Awards[/url][/i], organised by the local collective of game developers at [i][url=https://gamedevlisbon.com/]Game Dev Lisbon[/url][/i].[/b] In previous years, [i]Townseek[/i] and our team received nominations in different categories but didn't win any awards. This time, our team earned the nomination for [i]Studio of the Year[/i]. Alongside us as nominees, were the talented teams at [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/massivegalaxystudios]Massive Galaxy Studios[/url][/i], [i][url=https://www.funcom.com/funcom-zpx/]Funcom ZPX[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/digitality/]Digitality Games[/url][/i].

[b]Much to our surprise, [i]Whales And Games[/i] won [i]Studio of the Year[/i]![/b] 💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/8eae29ee6bd7593b4e3c0bcbdb70baee50bbd772.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/0663b262c9904ee92012efcfc75efc03956e4c28.jpg[/img]
[b]Being around our local community for many years, we're really grateful for the jury for having picked us among our colleagues![/b] Until our nomination, we hadn't stopped and reflected on the amount of work our studio did this past year. Between our trips and booths at [i]GDC[/i] and [i]gamescom[/i], to the continuous events we put together, to all the work we've been doing towards bringing [i]Townseek[/i] to its completion, we've really had a packed year! [b]We're proud to be part of the Portuguese community and grateful for its vote of confidence for the year ahead.[/b]

[b]The second award show of the event was the [i][url=https://devgamm.com/awards2024/]DevGAMM Awards[/url][/i], put together by the conference's main organizer.[/b] Being an international contest, this marked the first time we participated with [i][url=https://whalesandgames.com/games/townseek]Townseek[/url][/i] in an award show of its scale. We were very surprised when the international jury nominated us as one of the candidates for [i]Best Game in Portugal[/i]. Alongside us, we shared our nomination with the excellent [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332970/ARC_SEED/]ARC SEED[/url][/i], [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808160/Demon_Spore/]Demon Spore[/url][/i], [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839980/Gloomy_Juncture/]Gloomy Juncture[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281490/The_Night_is_Grey/]The Night is Gray[/url][/i], all of which have their own [i]Steam[/i] page! Our bets were on some of the other games receiving the award, as all of them rightfully deserved to earn it themselves.

[b]Against all our expectations, to the point it left us shaking in shock, [i]Townseek[/i] won [i]Best Game from Portugal![/i][/b] 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/f859dfd6692dce84f878df15f3cc4252f75bf552.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/bd7aa3658ed6cd6e390a9bcf43a8f73800e96b03.jpg[/img]
[b]We're incredibly thankful to both the judges and event organisers for considering our game a worthy winner. We also really appreciate the feedback they've shared with us![/b] Likewise, we also have to extend our thanks to [i][url=https://apvp.pt/]Associação de Produtores de Videojogos Portugueses[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://scorewarrior.com/]Scorewarrior[/url][/i] for delivering and making this award possible.

[b]If you'd like to review the award ceremony by itself, you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ygg7Kz2nJr0]watch the video here[/url]! [/b]You can also read a recap of the event by the organizers [url=https://devgamm.com/lisbon2024/event-highlights/]through this post[/url]. You can spot the photos featuring us because of our [i]Whales And Games[/i] themed hats! 🎩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/fa29470ee9818a5e98bb5dab7f5a60c63798f4ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/c02071d6179b2bd58ad55f476d16aff4b6605e28.jpg[/img]
[b]Lastly, but not least, alongside the [i]Spotlight Awards[/i] and the [i]DevGAMM Awards[/i], another long-running Portuguese showcase, [i][url=https://indiex.online/]Indie X Online[/url][/i], now in its sixth edition, also nominated us for [i]Best Portuguese Game[/i] earlier this month![/b] For that showcase, the award was won by [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/digitality/]Digitality Games[/url][/i] for their upcoming game [i]Floatylands[/i]. Still, we're thankful to [i]Indie X[/i] and once again to [i]Associação de Produtores de Videojogos Portugueses[/i] for including our game. [i]It's been quite an eventful month![/i]

[b]We're truly at a loss of words to express the gratitude we've felt over these past weeks.[/b] With everything that happened this year, we're privileged to have such overwhelming love and support from our friends, family, peers, colleagues, community, supporters and from such a diverse industry. [b]These awards inspire us to push forward with our work. We aim to make the industry and the world a better place, even if just by a little.[/b] ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/f1bc5222fa7f67c51b31580fd04d902328c262b5.png[/img]
While we have one last surprise related to the events we've attended throughout the year that we'll be posting on our social media channels fairly soon, this pretty much closes out our event season for the year. It's time for our team to prepare for the holidays. We want to take some time to focus primarily on the game and on our community. ☃️

[b]Finally, we wanted to close with a note for what's ahead, and we can confirm that [i]Townseek[/i] will release in 2025![/b] 🧭 As we head into next year, we'll confirm a proper release date. We would rather not go through the irony of submitting our game to these award shows again next year. 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/628ba9eb49458044e43d3f0a2e3e15cbd42a72c0.png[/img]

We've been wrapping up pending tasks for the game and made great strides despite some challenges these last months. From improving the narrative, improving mouse controls, adding achievements, random events, and overall rounding off the game, we've been really busy! We're also addressing some of the last issues raised in previous demos. We're really thrilled with how the game has been shaping up!

We'll be diving back into action and showing you more of the characters, locations, and details we have spread across [i]Explora[/i] soon! [b]As always, you can keep up with us by joining us on either our [url=https://discord.gg/whalesandgames][i]Discord server[/i][/url], through any of our [url=https://whalesandgames.com/links#socials]social media channels[/url], or by following us here on [i]Steam[/i]![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/whalesandgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/3bd105c0a70f45777c04667fe5407833c0664bd0.png[/img][/url]

[b]Well then, it's time for us to respond to these awards in kind, seek onwards, and finish charting [i]Townseek[/i]! Cheers![/b] 🦈

[b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b]

notes.title: Townseek heads to Germany for gamescom and the Indie Arena Booth! 🥨
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/3d8d669d8635145dc53137cbc9cf57496f4a6153.png[/img]

[b]We're excited to have [i]Townseek[/i] as part of this year's line up for the [i][url=https://indiearenabooth.de/event/presskit/14/16951]Indie Arena Booth[/url] at [url=http://gamescom.global]gamescom[/url][/i], flying the game all the way to Köln in Germany! Starting on the 21st until the 25th of August, we'll be showing the game at the world's largest gaming expo.[/b] 🌭 We'll be showing the game as part of the [i]Indie Arena Booth[/i] at F010G - E019 on Hall 10.2, alongside many other stellar games. In the case that you're visiting [i]gamescom[/i] in person, we'll be distributing cards and stickers featuring [i]Capt. Jawline[/i], [i]Whiskey[/i], [i]Fluffyroll[/i], and more familiar hosts from the game, so please stop by and grab some! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/ba4e4be64510dfe685e231e416c819d6df0ceb46.png[/img]
[b]This will also be the first time all of our team at [i]Whales And Games [/i]is together at one event! ✨[/b] We've always been partially as a team at different events we've had the game at since the beginning of development. While we're still checking on a new release date we're comfortable with, we've decided to change all of our banners and release date to reflect the game is [i]Coming Soon[/i] again.[/b] ⏳ We're still hard at work with [i]Townseek[/i], but some things have required more time than we're originally expecting. Continents are much more detailed than we ever thought they'd be, and we've almost doubled the game story-wise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/1c71d56e375c17faa43bd64daa7f3a544bb62531.png[/img]
We know many of you have been waiting for the game for a really long time. We really can't wait for you to get to visit [i]Explora[/i]! We'll have to ask you to wait just a bit longer, but with us being at such a big event such as [i]gamescom[/i], we promise more regular and exciting news in the coming future! 

[b]Thank you for sticking around and for waiting! Cheers![/b] 🦈

[b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b]

notes.title: Town Hubs, New Trading Experience, and Town Quests!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/e36f1c23d458dd1984b2977cf29385c6dfa9a2b0.png[/img]

[b]Hey there![/b] 👋 Other than our recent surprise release of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/3336618221382755073]Townseek's Early Demo[/url], you might have realised that we've been missing in action with these news posts lately.

[b]Things have been really busy for us these last months![/b] We've been working hard on [i]Townseek[/i] every day! We've been participating in industry events all over the world again, attending conferences like the [i]Game Developers Conference[/i] in [i]San Francisco[/i], seeking publishing opportunities and deals for [i]Townseek[/i] to push the game further. We've received new accolades, like being the golden bat winner at the [i][url=https://www.bigindiepitch.com/games/]Big Indie Pitch[/url][/i] in London, and participating in a multitude of [i]Steam events[/i]!

[b]And of course, there are also major milestones happening with [i]Whales And Games[/i], our studio which recently kicked off its [i][url=https://whalesandgames.com/2022/07/happy-5th-anniversary/]5th Anniversary[/url][/i] celebrations![/b] We're kicking off our 6th year by becoming an official limited liability company here in Portugal! It not only allows us to dedicate more time to [i]Townseek[/i] and our upcoming projects, but also gives us the opportunity to put together many more projects and opportunities that we hope to unveil in the future! 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/43525466458a1a72017ab98d98dd30e38fe2dcd8.png[/img]

[b]But most importantly, we continue working day-to-day on the game! So, let's catch up, and get right into some of the latest [i]Townseek[/i] news![/b] As announced last month, we are currently running an[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/announcements/detail/3336618221382755073] Early Demo for Townseek[/url][b] through[/b] [b][i]Steam[/i][/b] up until the [b]30th of July[/b]! The original date was earlier on the 28th of June, but we have extended it to go alongside our anniversary celebrations and this brand-new status report. If you haven't tried the early demo yet, this week is your best chance to do so! 

[b]Releasing this demo was a sudden decision for us.[/b] However, with the recent[url=https://dreamhack.com/beyond/] Dreamhack Beyond[/url] and[url=https://wholesomegames.com/] Wholesome Direct[/url] [i]Steam[/i] events, we felt this was the best opportunity for us to gather some feedback at this time. We also wanted to test out the initial impressions of player's of the game! [b]We're really happy about the feedback that we've received so far![/b] There are several tweaks and changes we already want to make in the game according to feedback we've received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/9ae468d204c0cf08335d2eeb3dec215a72a0b6cd.png[/img]

[b]But we'll be leaving the changes we plan to do with the feedback for a future post, as we first wanted to reflect on the changes we've made for [i]Townseek[/i] these past months.[/b] On the last big update we made on the status of the game back in [i]November[/i] of last year, we talked about how one of our goals was to focus more on major game systems.[b] Over the last months, that's precisely what we did![/b] With those changes, several aspects of the game were greatly revamped since the jam version! ✨

[b]Starting with towns, the town and trading experience in [i]Townseek[/i] has been massively overhauled![/b] With towns being the namesake of the game, our goal with the full version is to put much more focus on them. We want to bring unique charisma and attention to all of the different towns around the world. Originally, towns were just stops for trading, without much else to do besides exchanging inventory.

Now, when you visit a town, you're first presented with a [i]Town Hub[/i], which gives you a small description about the town and introduces you to the town's host. You also get snippets of information about how the town trades, such as currency, categories, and items in demand. This interface also has a lot more charisma, with unique banners, icons and backgrounds for each of the towns. [b]From this hub, you can select one of the three options of things to do there: [i]Trade with Town, Town Quests[/i] and [i]Talk with Host[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/027346dcca14bee35221d3daf98f0b27fefae620.png[/img]

[b]When you select[/b] [b][i]Trade with Town[/i] you're presented your options to exchange merchandise with towns.[/b] We've changed the way that items are presented into easily readable grids on both your inventory and the towns. Hovering over an item shows new information beyond just their flavour text, such as the item's category, average price, and the status of the item within the town.

[b]Item categories define how the price of an item fluctuates in a town.[/b] Different towns will have different preferences in which item categories they're looking for. Some towns will favour [i]Valuables[/i], while others might value [i]Food[/i]. While towns will favour some categories, there's a small chance you could be selling an item of the same category at a loss the next time you visit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/8726c3c69cbfbed630fda3e40c326ae614657118.png[/img]

[b]Towns will also sell unique items including [i]Upgrades[/i] and [i]Cosmetic Items[/i] for your airship. Most of these are, however,[/b] [b]locked behind a[/b] [b][i]Town's Reputation Rank[/i][/b]. As you sell new items to a town or complete town quests (more on that next), your [b][i]reputation[/i][/b] with them will increase. After you obtain a certain amount of [i]reputation points (RP)[/i], you'll rank up with that town!

Ranking up unlocks a slew of new items, better category fluctuations, and more. Rank up with towns all over the world to complete your collection and uncover new areas to explore!

[b]Finally, one new additional town trading feature are the [i]Items in Demand[/i]![/b] Towns each will have an item in demand that changes from a pool of possibilities every few minutes. These items sell for much higher price than their average value. If you happen to have these in your inventory, they're a great way for some quick profit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/00ec46df010cbf6fb937f50752438574213ed780.png[/img]

[b]Another big new aspect to towns are[/b] [b][i]Town Quests[/i]![/b] [i]Town Quests[/i] provide you with various tasks provided to you by each town's host. Some can include quests asking you to fetch certain items from other towns. You might have to engage in certain activities or deliver tourists from a town to a specific landmark in the world. There's even some unique quests depending on the location.

Completing [i]Town Quests[/i] rewards you with a greater amount of currency, reputation points and sometimes even items in a single go. Of course, rewards vary depending on the task, and the quests available rotate regularly. The amount of quests that you can take from a town at a time is limited. As you improve your [i]Town Reputation Rank[/i] you'll be able to take more quests at once. [b]With so many towns to explore, you'll have many quests at your disposal to tackle in the order you want![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/6c54d78ed5b6792b477f43b0706cb9219d75a4eb.png[/img]

These [i]Town Quests[/i] also relate to the [i]Journal of Sir Reginald Sharkingston[/i], as you'll have to perform various quest branches in order to collect the different pages from all over the different towns. We'll be going more in-depth about how the game's story will play out into the game in future reports. For now, simply know that the way pages are collected is built directly on top of these quest systems.

As development progresses, we'll continue balancing and experimenting with different town mechanics. Our goal is to create interesting and diverse quests. And of course, we're taking into consideration the feedback we've received with the [i]early demo. [b]We expect to have made massive improvements by the time that we get to show our game to the public again with a new demo! 💪[/b][/i]

[b]Additionally, as we mentioned previously in this post, we're currently looking into potential publishing opportunities for [i]Townseek[/i].[/b] We can't go in-depth at how conversations are headed at this time, but we believe that the game has some amazing possibilities headed its way! [b]We hope to be able to speak more about them soon![/b] 🤗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/e349051fb8aceec95d0a9bf6a0379f3800faf5bf.png[/img]

These last years of [i]Whales And Games[/i] were very transitional for us as developers, with us figuring out exactly what kinds of games we wanted to make, and trying to find our place in the industry. Gladly, our fifth year and working on [i]Townseek[/i] have helped us in all of those regards!

[b]We're incredibly grateful to be working on a project that means much to us.[/b] There are some really great people, even more than you might realise, helping us shape the project the best it can be! Of course, there's still a lot of work to be done until the game is actually out by next year and many more news will follow as the months go by. [b]We can't wait to show you some of the stuff we're cooking in the background! 👍[/b]

[url=https://whalesandgames.com/discord/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/3bd105c0a70f45777c04667fe5407833c0664bd0.png[/img][/url]

[b]If you end up taking the [i]Early Demo[/i] for a spin, we'd love to know your feedback through our [i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1659360/discussions/0/3415430580695712060/]Feedback Thread[/url][/i] or by hopping over to our [i][url=https://whalesandgames.com/discord/]Discord Server[/url][/i]![/b] Alternatively, if you prefer more bite-sized updates and sneak peaks rather than these longer news posts, we continue posting progress through both our [i][url=https://twitter.com/WhalesAndGames]Twitter[/url][/i] and through our [i][url=https://www.instagram.com/whalesandgames/]Instagram[/url][/i].

[b]Thank you to all of you who have wishlisted and followed [i]Townseek[/i] so far, and we can't wait to show you what's in store for the future! Cheers![/b]

[b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b]

notes.title: Remade Towns, Expanded Oceans and Indie X Stream!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/8c82b81dbd61d76548e1e4caab8907dd4b3feb37.png[/img]

[b]Hey there![/b] 👋 [b]It’s time for another update on how the development of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659360/Townseek/]Townseek[/url][/i] is progressing! As development on the full version continues, our focus has been on updating the content we’ve already got in-game.[/b] Our goal right now in early development is to keep improving on our existing jam game base, while we start to add some of the new content we’ve got planned on top.

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1659360/partnerevents/edit/3110292046089417936]On the last news update[/url][/b], we showed some early previews of our new art direction and some new locations. We showcased a new town, [i]Burrowburg[/i], and one of our new biomes, the [i]Golden Forest[/i]. [b]This time around, we’re creating brand-new areas, while also improving on the existing content![/b] ✨

[b]Bear in mind that all the placement of locations and how the game currently looks is not final![/b] We’re still experimenting with some elements, and the final product might look different in some ways. But for now, we’d say that the direction is right on track! 🦈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/5aa8aa0565585f82463b53899f1d908d3db46b9c.png[/img]

[b]Coming back from the original jam version, we’ve remade the towns of [i]Meowosville[/i], [i]Driplands[/i], and [i]Lawride Town[/i] with our new art direction in mind![/b]Since we want these towns to feel more like a natural extension of the world this time around, they actually extend beyond their interacting area, populating more of the continents where they reside. The [i]Driplands[/i] extend towards the nearby swamp, complete with crocodiles and frogs. [i]Meowosville[/i] has a denser forest than [i]Burrowburg[/i] and is close to a familiar dog park. [i]Lawride Town[/i] is beyond a mountain belt, surrounded by nature and bandits.

[b]Aside from the towns and continents, we’re also focused on giving the ocean some additional personality![/b] You can spot sharks, whales, and corals, and even some new landmarks! Given how important the ocean is to the world of [i]Townseek[/i], we felt it was necessary to spice it up too. We want there to be more ocean towns, and for the sea to add even more to the ambience of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/47209d989fb76ac682ef7ccdfe9ed088d7c95eaf.png[/img]

[b]Another one of our goals for the game is to make as much of the sound design reactive and dynamic as possible.[/b] In addition to each town having its own set of instruments that plays when the player is in their proximity, we’re also adding in unique music tracks to each area of the map, giving each zone their own musical personality! 🎵

[b]We’re also doubling-down on the unique ambient sounds and details for the new mini-biomes.[/b] In the [i]Mossy Marsh[/i] that neighbours the [i]Driplands[/i] you’ll be able to hear the sounds of the frogs and flies while flying above it. Likewise, you can hear a chilly breeze when you’re in the snowy-regions and mountain tops. We’ve also added an extra variety of forest and ocean sounds too!

[previewyoutube=DKrnWqBW_8o;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Finally, but not least, we had the pleasure to sit down with [i]João Correia[/i] from [i][url=https://indiex.online/]Indie X[/url][/i], Portugal’s biggest indie game showcase, for a first look at the full version of [i]Townseek[/i]![/b] While most of the gameplay so far is based on the jam version of the game, we invite you to watch the recording of the stream! 🎥

[previewyoutube=GSFpKiorLoY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]During the stream, we talk about some of the gameplay work we’ve been doing in the background.[/b] These include improving our codebase and some of the new systems we have implemented in the background. Our goals for the next months are to continue implementing some of the new systems, features and side-activities we’ve got planned!

[url=https://discord.gg/whalesandgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/3bd105c0a70f45777c04667fe5407833c0664bd0.png[/img][/url]

[b]And that’s it for this update! The holidays are practically here, so put your jolly face and [url=https://discord.whalesandgames.com/]join us at our Discord server[/url] to share the holiday spirit![/b] And make sure to follow us out on [i][url=https://twitter.com/whalesandgames]Twitter[/url][/i] for more [i]Townseek[/i] previews!

December will be packed with things to do, but we’ll do our best to make this into a memorable end of the year! [b]If we don’t see you until then, then have some great holidays! Cheers![/b] ⛄

[b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b]

notes.title: Townseek’s New Art Direction, Burrowburg and the Golden Forest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/241752dfc70025563e76c22d332e72c8610ca07f.png[/img]

[b]Hey there! 👋 Since it’s been a while since the game’s announcement, we wanted to begin providing some updates about how development of the full version of [i]Townseek[/i] is progressing![/b] While we normally post full [i]Status Reports [/i]at our [url=https://whalesandgames.com/blog]studio’s blog[/url] that cover everything we’re working on across projects and our community, our news posts here will be exclusively focused on [i]Townseek’s [/i]development, unless one of those additional projects or community events happens to involve the game as well!

[b]Our goal is to post these on a regular monthly basis! [/b]Sometimes we might take a bit longer or an extra month, but rest assured we’re always working our hardest and giving our best on the game! [b]💪[/b]

There are a lot of new features we want to include in our new full version of the game that we’re currently developing. These are even more apparent if you’ve played our original [i]Jam Version[/i] of [i]Townseek[/i]. [b]One of these is a new, colourful art direction that’s accompanied by a much larger and interesting world to explore! Today, and to get started with one of these news posts, we wanted to show you a peak of how that art style is coming along.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/29c5cb54269f766054c9b7cc87d9658fb964bc4c.png[/img]

[b]At this time, we’re currently working on blocking out our new world map and detailing our first continents and areas. [/b]We’ve had the chance to experiment with our new art direction by designing a new continent that is host to the town of [i]Burrowburg[/i] and their adorable bunny inhabitants!

Our end goal is to take the same soothing and curiosity-inducing feeling of the previous sepia-style map from the original game [i]Jam Version[/i] and translate it to this brand new colourful art direction. [b]We’re aiming to give more charisma to each individual location and make each place you visit a memorable one![/b]

Speaking of locations, in our previous version of the game, you could come across landmarks that were independent points of interest, like a big character or some interesting monument, spread across the map that you’d stumble upon and discover. [b]In the full version, however, we want to have groups of landmarks that are part of larger zones all-together.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/29ce5680d840cd8e1475b56843e17c3dae93eda8.png[/img]

[b]One of these new landmark areas we’re currently working on is the [i]Golden Forest[/i], an area filled with autumn and maple coloured trees.[/b] Despite being its own big area, it is also the host to its own smaller landmarks like a [i]Beehive Colony[/i]. 🐝

[b]Of course, that’s just one of the many areas that we’ve got planned for this full version![/b] From snowy and icy peaks, marshes and beaches, there’s a lot of new stuff to love in this map of the game, and we hope that you look forward to exploring it!

[b]In future updates we also hope to share some more insight on how some of our game mechanics are going to come together. [/b]Up until now, towns in the game were mostly trading outputs, where you could sell and buy items to have enough gold to purchase balloons and tools. We want to increase the protagonism of towns and we have some systems designed through which we hope to achieve just that!

[b]For now, make sure to add the game to your wishlist! It really does help us out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/713ffc047d97046b3a685e93f6c301c9b6bf69f3.png[/img]

[b]While the holiday season seems to already be quickly approaching, we’re still celebrating our community’s [i]Whaloween [/i]event until next week![/b] [b][url=https://discord.whalesandgames.com/]Make sure you keep your spooky costumes on and join us there![/url] [/b]You can also follow us over on our [b][i][url=https://twitter.com/whalesandgames]Twitter[/url][/i][/b] where we frequently share [i]Screenshot Saturdays [/i]previews[i] [/i]of [i]Townseek[/i]!

[url=https://discord.gg/whalesandgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227693/3bd105c0a70f45777c04667fe5407833c0664bd0.png[/img][/url]

As we continue developing our art style and as we have more progress to share, we hope to see you in future posts! [b]Cheers![/b]

[b]– Whales And Games 🐳[/b]
